title: agent-chat-gateway config.yaml
description: Hand-written schema for editor autocomplete / typo-checking of config.yaml. It intentionally does NOT re-validate every connector-type-specific field (server/allowed_users/attachments/agent_chain vary by connector 'type') — that stays the job of `acg config validate`. See docs/migration-0.3.md for the format this schema describes (v0.3+: connector_templates/agent_templates/watcher_templates + per-entry 'inherits:', tool_presets, watcher rooms:).

tool_presets.description: Named, reusable lists of inline tool rules. Reference a preset by name from owner_allowed_tools/guest_allowed_tools. A preset's own list may only contain inline rules (no preset-of-presets).

agent_templates.description: Named, reusable field blocks for agents. Reference one by name via an agent's 'inherits:' field (the agent's own fields win on conflict; flat one-tier merge — no nested templates).

description.description: Optional annotation for this template (informational only; never merged into entries).

connector_templates.description: Named, reusable field blocks for connectors. Reference one by name via a connector's 'inherits:' field. Must not set 'name' — that identifies a specific connector. No nested templates.

description.description: Optional annotation for this template (informational only; never merged into entries).

watcher_templates.description: Named, reusable field blocks for watchers. Reference one by name via a watcher's 'inherits:' field. Must not set 'name', 'room', 'rooms', or 'session_id' — those identify a specific watcher. No nested templates.

description.description: Optional annotation for this template (informational only; never merged into entries).

default_agent.description: Name of the agent used when a watcher omits 'agent:'. Defaults to the first agent defined.

max_queue_depth.description: Max pending messages per room queue; 0 = unbounded.

tool.description: Regex matched against the tool name (case-insensitive, fullmatch).

params.description: Optional regex matched against the tool's primary parameter (command / url / file_path / full JSON, depending on the tool).

toolEntry.description: Either the name of a 'tool_presets:' entry (string), or an inline tool rule (object). The two forms may be freely mixed in one list.

connector.description: additionalProperties is intentionally left open — server/allowed_users/attachments/agent_chain and other fields vary by connector 'type' (rocketchat/mattermost/voice/script) and are validated by each connector's own config parser, not by this schema.

description.description: Optional annotation for this connector (informational only; ignored at runtime).

inherits.description: Name of a 'connector_templates:' entry to deep-merge as this connector's base (this connector's own fields win on conflict).

description.description: Optional annotation for this agent (informational only; ignored at runtime).

inherits.description: Name of an 'agent_templates:' entry to deep-merge as this agent's base (this agent's own fields win on conflict). Templates cannot themselves set 'inherits'.

type.description: Required (directly or via an inherits: agent_templates entry) — no fallback.

command.description: Defaults based on 'type' when omitted ('claude' for type: claude, 'opencode' for type: opencode) — not a single fixed fallback.

working_directory.description: Required (directly or via an inherits: agent_templates entry); must exist on disk when the gateway loads.

session_idle_days.description: Days with no message before a watcher's runtime object is dropped (session kept). Omit, or set explicitly to null to suppress an inherited value, for no idle lifecycle. Must be strictly less than session_expire_days when both are set. See docs/design/dynamic-watcher-design.md.

session_expire_days.description: Days with no message before the session itself is dropped too. Omit, or set explicitly to null to suppress an inherited value, for no expiry. See docs/design/dynamic-watcher-design.md.

watcher.description: A 'watchers:' entry, in either shape. The two are told apart by the type of 'rooms': an object is a rule (docs/design/dynamic-watcher-design.md §2.1), an array is the static multi-room shorthand. Exactly one branch can match, so 'oneOf' is a discriminated union rather than a guess. Both are accepted while the rule path is being built; the static branch is removed at cutover.

dmOptIn.description: Opt in to a DM class. Only true/false is accepted by the loader today. The object form is reserved for per-DM include/exclude (§2.7) and is accepted here so that adding it later extends this union instead of changing the schema's shape — a config written against the newer loader still validates against this schema.

description.description: Optional annotation for this rule (informational only; ignored at runtime).

inherits.description: Name of a 'watcher_templates:' entry to deep-merge as this rule's base (this rule's own fields win on conflict).

name.description: The rule's identity — required and unique. Unlike the static shape there is no single room to derive a name from, and this is what shadowing warnings and persisted rule_name refer to.

rooms.description: Which rooms this rule claims. Patterns govern named rooms; the DM flags govern direct messages, which have no name to match on either platform. All four may appear together.

include.description: Globs ('*', '?', '[...]') matched against the room's full name, anchored at both ends, case-sensitively. Required unless the rule opts into DMs only.

exclude.description: Evaluated after include, within this rule. An excluded room does NOT fall through to a later rule — this rule claimed it and then declined it.

session_idle_days.description: Days with no message before this watcher's runtime object is dropped (session kept). Lives on the rule rather than the agent so two rules sharing an agent can differ. Must be strictly less than session_expire_days when both are set.

session_expire_days.description: Days with no message before the session itself is dropped too.

description.description: Optional annotation for this watcher (informational only; ignored at runtime).

inherits.description: Name of a 'watcher_templates:' entry to deep-merge as this watcher's base (this watcher's own fields win on conflict).

name.description: Only allowed when the entry has exactly one room; auto-derived from connector+room otherwise.

room.description: Exactly one room; alias for rooms: [<room>].

rooms.description: Bind this connector+agent pair to several rooms at once; expands into one watcher per room.

exclude_room.description: Only meaningful once room: "*" (rule-based room matching) is implemented; the loader currently rejects room: "*" outright with a 'not implemented yet' error regardless of this field. See docs/design/dynamic-watcher-design.md.

session_id.description: Only allowed when the entry has exactly one room.
